items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries: OUT/DOUBTFUL include Bowers, Collins, Flowers/Lane, Murray/Jennings, AJ Brown, Darnold, Penix/Tua, Okonkwo; Q: McConkey, Olave, Burrow (playing), Pittman, Harvey, Black, McMillan; IN: Henderson, Pierce, Coker, Kamara, Tucker.
items.implication: Key status changes for lineup decisions; beneficiaries in thinned rooms (BAL/HOU/NE WRs crumbs).
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups in affected offenses.

items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable for Sunday vs Raiders (ribs).
items.why: Ribs; practiced Friday after missing earlier.
items.implication: Game-time; biggest slate injury per Levitan, impacts Herbert projections. 4pm ET start.
items.opportunity: If OUT, boost to other LAC WRs like Quentin Johnston.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring injury sustained in Wednesday practice; missed Thu/Fri practices; Grade 1 not serious long-term.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; HOU WR room thinned, volume to others/TE.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints (hamstring).
items.why: Missed multiple practices with hamstring; returned Friday but doubtful.
items.implication: Likely sit; high risk if plays. BAL WR hierarchy shifts.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining BAL WRs/TEs if OUT.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers (knee), per HC.
items.why: Knee/meniscus; practiced Friday after prior absence but doubtful.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer or other LV TEs for targets.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN and ready; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR—potential 10+ touches in debut vs good stretch of matchups. Unclear vs Stevenson.
items.why: Ready to go; AJ Brown IR creates need for explosives; nice upcoming schedule.
items.implication: Monitor for expanded role/shares; handcuff/starter potential.
items.opportunity: Carries/targets expansion at Stevenson's expense possible.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for SF RB shares.
items.why: Week 1 usage strong; Black Q impacts depth.
items.opportunity: High snap/touch share if Black limited.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable (back) but he said he's playing vs Texans.
Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: handled 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead); IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage + juicy matchup. 24% tgt share (tied lead, career high-ish).
items.implication: Strong RB start; RB1 overall range possible ROS.

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share recent, 25+ touches in 3/4 last.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; overreaction to injury scare.

items.text: Dak Prescott on LOVE list vs WAS: home 21.3 PPG last yr; WAS torched 14.5 ypc/3 TDs W1; high total/implied.
Back in on DeVonta Smith @ TEN (LOVE): 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT with deep looks Week 1; TEN soft vs WR (85% catch, 16 ypr).
items.why: Strong usage + matchup despite tough W1.

items.text: Loves Bucky Irving vs CLE: career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; CLE soft vs run.
Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL (Kamara return squeezes role, underdog script) and Marvin Harrison Jr vs SEA (8% tgt share W1, no RZ, SEA tough vs WR).
items.why: Etienne: matched Miller rushes, air-dependent, Kamara back. MHJ: low share.
items.opportunity: Reduced for Etienne with Kamara IN.
